en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small village in a narrow valley surrounded by forested hills and patchwork farmland. A cluster of traditional gabled houses, some half‑timbered, stands along a road and small stream in the center. Rolling grassy slopes with scattered trees fill the foreground, and dense conifer woods cover the hills on both sides. Faint handwritten numbers or words appear upside‑down along the top margin.
